job.title: Backend Engineering Intern (Python/FastAPI)
job.raw_text: We are looking for a Backend Engineering Intern proficient in Python and FastAPI to build clean REST APIs. You will work with SQL databases, write unit and integration tests, and help containerize services for deployment with GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.

assessments.summary: Idiomatic Python 3 module structure using typed Pydantic models and list comprehensions in app/main.py.

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI(title='Student API')

class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float
